It is neither a tandoori chicken nor the butter chicken that was pioneered by Moti Mahal. It is Aslam's version of a tandoori butter chicken! Once the chicken is cooked, the pieces are put in a large bowl and secret masalas are sprinkled on top of it, and then some cream is splashed over it. Melted butter is then poured over the chicken in the bowl. Needless to say, the final dish is simply out of this world. Besides its amazing butter chicken, Aslam's is also known for its soft chicken seekh kebabs and fish tikka, all of which is served with rumali rotis!   Price for 2 - Rs.500  So, if you are craving some street food style butter chicken which is actually butter+chicken and not just chicken thrown in some sweet tomato gravy, you know where to head! Whether it is a legendary restaurant, or a famous street food outlet, or a hidden gem, we'll travel across the city to bring to you the best of Indian street food, local restaurants and much more. Once the chicken is cooked, the pieces are put in a large bowl and secret masalas are sprinkled on top of it, and then some cream is splashed over it. Melted butter is then poured over the chicken in the bowl. Needless to say, the final dish is simply out of this world. Besides its amazing butter chicken, Aslam's is also known for its soft chicken seekh kebabs and fish tikka, all of which is served with rumali rotis! Price for 2 - Rs.500 So, if you are craving some street food style butter chicken which is actually butter+chicken and not just chicken thrown in some sweet tomato gravy, you know where to head!
